note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Ancestral Spirit
spells.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

spells.name: Astral Recall
spells.description: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to home. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

spells.name: Call of the Ancestors
spells.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

spells.name: Call of the Elements
spells.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

spells.name: Call of the Spirits
spells.description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

spells.name: Chain Heal
spells.description: Heals the friendly target for 474 to 538, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 119 to 133 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

spells.name: Cure Disease
spells.description: Cures 1 disease on the target.

spells.name: Cure Poison
spells.description: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

spells.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
spells.description: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.

spells.name: Earth Shock
spells.description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 293 to 309 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

spells.name: Earthbind Totem
spells.description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

spells.name: Far Sight
spells.description: Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.

spells.name: Fire Nova
spells.description: Instantly inflicts 413 to 459 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.

spells.name: Fire Resistance Totem
spells.description: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.

spells.name: Flame Shock
spells.description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 166 Fire damage immediately and 176 Fire damage over 12 sec.

spells.name: Flametongue Totem
spells.description: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit causes 17 to 55 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Flametongue Weapon
spells.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 35 to 112 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

spells.name: Frost Resistance Totem
spells.description: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 60, if within 30 yards.

spells.name: Frost Shock
spells.description: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 278 to 294 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.

spells.name: Frostbrand Weapon
spells.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 169 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 60 minutes.

spells.name: Ghost Wolf
spells.description: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.

spells.name: Grace of Air Totem
spells.description: Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Grounding Totem
spells.description: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.

spells.name: Healing Stream Totem
spells.description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 11 every 2 seconds.

spells.name: Healing Wave
spells.description: Heals a friendly target for 1,508 to 1,722.

spells.name: Lava Burst
spells.description: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 192 to 248 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

spells.name: Lesser Healing Wave
spells.description: Heals a friendly target for 775 to 865.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 189 to 211 Nature damage.

spells.name: Lightning Shield
spells.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 178 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Magma Totem
spells.description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 73 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.

spells.name: Mana Spring Totem
spells.description: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

spells.name: Mana Tide Totem
spells.description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

spells.name: Nature Resistance Totem
spells.description: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.

spells.name: Nature's Swiftness
spells.description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

spells.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
spells.description: Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Purge
spells.description: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.

spells.name: Rage of the Farseer
spells.description: Increases your melee attack speed and spell casting speed by 30% for 25 sec.

spells.name: Reincarnation
spells.description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

spells.name: Riptide
spells.description: Heals a friendly target for 799 to 883, an additional 805 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

spells.name: Rockbiter Weapon
spells.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 653 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

spells.name: Searing Totem
spells.description: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 to 54 Fire damage.

spells.name: Sentry Totem
spells.description: Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it. Right-Click on buff to switch back and forth between totem sight and shaman sight.

spells.name: Stoneclaw Totem
spells.description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 486 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.

spells.name: Stoneskin Totem
spells.description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 30. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Stormstrike
spells.description: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

spells.name: Strength of Earth Totem
spells.description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Totemic Projection
spells.description: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.

spells.name: Totemic Recall
spells.description: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

spells.name: Tremor Totem
spells.description: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

spells.name: Water Shield
spells.description:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

spells.name: Water Walking
spells.description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.

spells.name: Windfury Totem
spells.description: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party members nearby. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 246 extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.

spells.name: Windfury Weapon
spells.description: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 333 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.

spells.name: Windwall Totem
spells.description: Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 64. Lasts 5 min.
